summary: Standalone Z.4 import packet for Dedekind projectives and rank/determinant K0. The accepted Z.3 companion already supplies all 43 target nodes, with 45 API items, 26 definition tests and six planets. No duplicate nodes are introduced. The issue predecessor U.1 has no Z.4 coverage. This pass provides a complete standalone reader, an explicit target/import inventory, fresh source and selected-baseline evidence, and a compact suggested file elaborated at the pins. Source-decomposed is a planning status; all implementation statuses remain unchecked. Assembly must retain the existing node IDs and count the imported nodes and planets only once.
